all.reason: This change tightens the proof that lets the translator retire an object when its frame ends: an object whose only callee is a native method (Thread.start) is no longer retired early, because the root scan then read a live Thread as freed and the sweep finalized it. Fewer objects are retired early, so peak RAM can only rise, and hello is the one workload small enough for that to show. Run for 3d3119ed9d, five rounds: hello RAM 1.01 against 0.87 on Linux arm64 and 1.22 against 0.77 on Windows x64, the same direction Windows arm64 moved earlier. Timing and tolerances are kept.

Timing and tolerances are kept.
